source.dataset: COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Health & Human Services / CDC NHSN
source.note: Facility-level operational reporting. Self-reported by hospitals via HHS TeleTracking or state health departments; not independently audited. Excludes VA, IHS, DoD, psychiatric and rehabilitation facilities by design.
source.suppression: Counts of -999999 are CDC privacy suppression of small numbers. Stored as null: missing, not zero.

selection.label: Phoenix metro, AZ
selection.rationale: Independent replication region, lower facility density.
selection.chosen_by: authors -- not derived from the data; swept in sensitivity analysis
selection.reference_week_note: The week used to decide which facilities are in the network and how big they are. Simulation weeks are chosen separately.
